evidence: In kernels/custom_ops.cu, clip_01_kernel contains only a placeholder loop with no actual computation or output writes.
clip_01_launcher passes total_elements but kernel cannot map linear index to multidimensional coordinates without H and W, so no elements are written.

verification.json shows ~50% mismatched elements with actual values all 0.0 while expected are in [0,1], consistent with uninitialized memory (often zero on fresh allocations) or all-zero output from clip kernel.
diagnostic.json reports step_001 matched=true (sum output correct) but step_002 mismatched (clip broken), confirming root cause is clip_01.
binding.cpp calls .contiguous() before launcher, so both input and output are contiguous; a simple linear clip over total_elements is sufficient.

Simplify clip_01_launcher to pass only total_elements and stream, removing unused stride parameters.
Update custom_ops_binding.cpp extern declaration for clip_01_launcher to match new signature.
Ensure kernel handles NaN correctly: fmaxf(fminf(val,1.0f),0.0f) returns NaN for NaN input, matching torch.clip.
Verify grid-stride loop covers all elements and grid size is within CUDA limits.
